method: Structured JSON from the Gemini API, instructed by docs/PROJECT_VISION.md@main blob fe2f414774b7. All records provisional.

characters.summary: Rudy Gobert is a dominant defensive center known for his elite rim protection, rebounding, and screen-setting abilities. He relies on exceptional height, length, and positioning to contest shots and anchor interior defense.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to being isolated on the perimeter against quick guards
limitations: Limited offensive repertoire outside of the paint

sources.supports: Defensive career, shot-blocking, and overall playing style

notableResults.note: Multiple Defensive Player of the Year awards won

unknowns: Exact defensive impact metrics vary by advanced analytical model

characters.summary: Russell Westbrook is an explosive point guard driven by unmatched athleticism, relentless pace, and high-volume driving. He exerts pressure on opposing defenses through high-speed transition attacks and aggressive rebounding.
weaknesses: Prone to high turnover counts when forcing plays
limitations: Relies heavily on high energy and supreme athleticism

sources.supports: Athletic profile, triple-double history, and playstyle

notableResults.note: Averaged a triple-double over multiple seasons

unknowns: Performance fluctuates based on team roster fit and role definition

characters.summary: Sam Jones was a clutch shooting guard renowned for his bank shot, exceptional speed, and calm demeanor under pressure. He was a cornerstone of the Boston Celtics dynasty.
limitations: Played in an era with different offensive spacing and rules

sources.supports: Championship history, bank shot technique, and career profile

notableResults.note: Won 10 NBA championships with the Celtics

unknowns: Detailed defensive statistics from his era are incomplete

characters.summary: Scottie Pippen was a versatile forward and one of the greatest perimeter defenders in basketball history. He combined length, quickness, and elite court vision to excel as a primary playmaker and stopper.

sources.supports: Defensive prowess, playmaking abilities, and championship history

notableResults.note: Secured six NBA championships and multiple All-Defensive First Team selections

unknowns: Extent of offensive output when separated from primary co-star

characters.summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is a crafty guard who uses deceleration, exceptional body control, and midrange mastery to dismantle defenses. He draws fouls at a high rate and operates with extreme poise.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy double-teams if supporting shooting is absent
limitations: Moderate volume from three-point range compared to primary midrange reliance

sources.supports: Scoring profile, midrange statistics, and playstyle

notableResults.note: Finished high in MVP voting and led deep playoff runs

unknowns: Long-term playoff scaling under sustained defensive traps

characters.summary: Shaquille O'Neal was an immensely powerful center whose unmatched combination of size, strength, and surprising agility made him virtually unguardable in the paint. He overwhelmed opponents physically on both ends.
weaknesses: Poor free-throw shooting percentage exploited by the Hack-a-Shaq strategy
limitations: Ineffective outside of the restricted area

sources.supports: Physical dominance, career statistics, and championships

notableResults.note: Won three consecutive Finals MVP awards

characters.summary: Shawn Kemp was an explosive power forward known for high-flying dunks, fierce rebounding, and aggressive athleticism. He served as the primary interior force for the Seattle SuperSonics.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to foul trouble when overly aggressive

sources.supports: Athletic profile, dunking highlights, and career history

notableResults.note: Lost series despite strong individual performances

characters.summary: Spud Webb was an unusually short point guard who utilized extraordinary vertical leap, speed, and ball-handling to compete effectively in the NBA. He famously won the Slam Dunk Contest despite his height.
weaknesses: Severe height disadvantage against tall guards and shot blockers
limitations: Limited ability to contest high-release shots or pull-ups from tall opponents

sources.supports: Height statistics, vertical leap feats, and Slam Dunk Contest win

notableResults.note: Won the competition using extreme leaping ability

unknowns: Overall defensive impact limited strictly by physical dimensions

characters.summary: Stephen Curry is a revolutionary point guard and the game's greatest shooter, leveraging endless off-ball movement, lightning-quick release, and deep shooting range to break defenses.
weaknesses: Targeted on switches by bigger, physical post players
limitations: Requires active teammate screens to generate optimal separation
